svg.title: Breastfeeding trouble sorted by which of the three needs broke: low supply split by the latch into inadequate production or poor extraction, nipple or breast pain (mastitis pointed to the breast chart), and stopping, either because breastfeeding is contraindicated or because she chooses to wean; each column gives what to look for and how to manage it, with panels on the first week and on contraception while breastfeeding
